title: Bootstrap run tracking and inventory the first-drive baseline
goal: Prove Sol can rerun a task, record every outcome, and identify the exact Richmond bundle used for comparison.

inputs.rights: User-supplied baseline. Preserve the bundled source and attribution notices.

deliverables.purpose: Standard-library entry point; record start, finalize status and recover an interrupted run.
Read-only ZIP and optional HTML inventory.
Actual input hashes, archive contents, route and match statistics.
Offline fixtures exercising the runner and inventory.
Current task status, chronological history, evidence and next action.

out_of_scope: Changing the input artifacts, downloading GIS, installing Unreal or building gameplay.
steps: Inspect inputs and existing project conventions.
Implement the runner and inventory, and exercise success, failure, interruption recovery and retries in isolated fixtures.
Run the actual audit through the runner and inspect its evidence.

acceptance.procedure: Test valid fixture twice and compare inventory digests.
acceptance.pass_if: Two distinct run records; unchanged deterministic inventory; no input mutation.

acceptance.procedure: Exercise missing ZIP, damaged ZIP and an interrupted run using an isolated temporary project.
acceptance.pass_if: Missing input is BLOCKED, damaged input is FAILED, stale RUNNING is recovered exactly once; each outcome has evidence; preserve observed exit codes and use null for an unknown interrupted exit.

acceptance.procedure: Run the actual baseline through the entry point; cross-check inventory against the ZIP and perform the placeholder scan.
acceptance.pass_if: Hashes and counts are computed, discrepancies are recorded, Markdown history contains the run, and changed implementation contains no placeholders.

on_blocked: Finish and test independent work; record the exact missing input, evidence and smallest resumption command.
retry: Same inputs reproduce baseline.json. A retry adds exactly one run record and preserves earlier history.
